title: console: a deep link to an object of a disabled package hangs forever on the "Opening your console…" splash — `isMetaItemAbsentError` does not read `404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` as an answered absence, and the first-paint gate has no exit
body:
Filing gate: ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction (QA-measured).

Path: platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable (objectstack checklist item, priority P1) — the item fails on this clause, so triage inherits its priority.
Type: Bug (prefilled — violates the console's declared "named not-found inside the shell, never a dead page" behaviour that the same build honours for an unknown object)
QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#24557 · platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable · acceptance[5]

reach: measured once through the public UI — `/_console/apps/showcase_app/qaprobe_widget` after `PATCH /api/v1/packages/com.qa.probe/disable` stays on the full-page "ObjectOS · Opening your console…" splash for 60 s+ (framework 5b14b7f3, console pin 4016370a); reproduced 2/2 by the runner and 2/2 by an independent verifier.

## What happens

A deep link to an object whose owning package has been **disabled** never leaves the boot splash: no app chrome, no not-found, no error, no retry. The server answers correctly and promptly (`404 OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`, a registered ADR-0112 code declared for exactly this case), but the console treats that answer as "no answer obtained" and its first-paint gate waits forever.

Control in the same build: an object that does not exist (`/_console/apps/showcase_app/no_such_object_xyz`) gets `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` and renders a named "Object Not Found" inside the Showcase shell.

## Reproduction

1. Boot the objectstack showcase (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`); `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-in/email {"email":"admin@objectos.ai","password":"admin123"}`.
2. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.probe","name":"QA Probe","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qaprobe"}}` → 201.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qaprobe_widget?mode=draft&package=com.qa.probe {"name":"qaprobe_widget","label":"QA Widget","sharingModel":"public_read_write","fields":{"name":{"type":"text"}}}` → 200; `POST /api/v1/packages/com.qa.probe/publish-drafts {}` → 200.
4. `PATCH /api/v1/packages/com.qa.probe/disable {}` → 200. Now `GET /api/v1/meta/object/qaprobe_widget` → `404 {"error":"Object 'qaprobe_widget' belongs to a disabled package and is not being served. …","code":"OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED"}`.
5. Sign in at `/_console/login`, open `/_console/apps/showcase_app/qaprobe_widget`.
   - expected: the Showcase shell with a named not-found (ideally "this object's package is disabled") state.
   - actual: the boot splash, indefinitely. Network: two `GET /api/v1/meta/object/qaprobe_widget` → 404 `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED`, then silence.

## Mechanism (read at the pin 4016370a; objectui main 61ed5ada is identical)

1. The deep link reads the app's object scope; `qaprobe_widget` is not in the scope list, so it is fetched by name via `fetchScopeName` (`packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`).
2. `readItem`'s catch returns `failed: !isMetaItemAbsentError(err)`; `isMetaItemAbsentError` (`packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts`) matches only `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, so `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` is classed `failed`.
3. On a failed read `fetchScopeName` drops the name without a re-render (deliberate, objectui#13009) and the scope stays `settled: false`.
4. `routeReadsSettled` (`packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`) never becomes true, so the first-paint gate keeps rendering `LoadingScreen` — no exit, no error state.

Discriminator (Playwright response rewrite, status kept at 404): a wrapped `{"error":{"code":"OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED"}}` body still hangs; a body with code `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` (flat or wrapped) renders the named not-found. The **code value** decides, not the envelope shape — so this is not fixable by changing the framework's envelope, and changing the code would contradict the framework's declared `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` contract.

Fix direction (for the implementer to decide): read `OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED` as an answered absence (best with a named "package disabled" state in the shell), and/or give the first-paint gate an exit on a definite 4xx by-name read so no future refusal code can hang it.

## Filing-gate answers

- Category: ① (QA-measured product defect, named location, reproduction above).
- Acting reader: the objectui console / app-shell lane dev — the change is in `packages/data-objectstack` (`isMetaItemAbsentError`) and/or `packages/app-shell` (`MetadataProvider.tsx` / `AppContent.tsx`).
- Duplicate search (open AND closed), objectui: "console stuck on Opening your console splash deep link object of disabled package OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED isMetaItemAbsentError" → 3 hits (#12285, #12335, #11645 — none this defect); "first paint splash never ends by-name object read failed fetchScopeName routeReadsSettled loading screen forever" → 2 hits (#12809, #11331 — none this defect). objectstack: "OBJECT_PACKAGE_DISABLED error envelope flat body console hangs deep link disabled package object" → 2 hits (#23505, #22817 — none).
